$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the only one whose recall is not an endpoint. 7/9 sits above
the 0.70 floor and below 1, so a change that tightens matching drops it under the floor and a change
that loosens it rounds it up to the ceiling. Either direction is visible here and nowhere else.
The two rows it misses are both non-CRITICAL on purpose, which pins the second half of the point:
overall recall can move while CRITICAL recall stays at its own threshold of 1.00.
derivation: The report cites seven of the nine planted rows at their firing lines: C1, C3, C4, C5, H1, H3 and H4.
L1 (seeded/checkout.spec.ts:19) and H10 (seeded/orders.service.spec.ts:39) are absent, so hits is 7
and misses holds those two, in the order ground truth lists them: checkout's plants come first, and
L1 is third within that file.
All four C rows are among the seven, so criticalHits is 4 of 4.
Every finding matched a plant and nothing was reported against the clean control, so falsePositives
and unattributed are both 0 and reported is 7.
The counts the harness derives from these: recall 7/9 = 0.7778, above the 0.70 floor and short of the
ceiling. CRITICAL recall 4/4 = 1.00, exactly its threshold. nonFalsePositiveRate (7 - 0)/7 = 1.00.
The trailing prose block under Recommendations carries neither a Location nor a Row, so it is not a
finding and reported stays 7. That is deliberate: it keeps a prose paragraph from inflating the
score and recommendation come from the verdict: 100 - 4x10 - 3x5 - 0x2 - 0x1 = 45, Block on Criticals.
